en.summary: Moonlight Peaks is a cozy farming sim from Little Chicken, published by Marvelous Europe and XSEED Games, that released July 6, 2026. Instead of the usual sunlit village, players take on the role of Count Dracula's child, kicked out after a family argument, who builds a new farm life in a gothic town shared with witches, werewolves, and mermaids — running entirely on a nocturnal schedule.

guideSections.title: Nocturnal Schedule & Sun-Shield Potions
guideSections.description: Your character wakes at 6 PM and must be home by 6 AM or take sunlight damage; a craftable Sun-Shield Potion later in the game allows limited safe daytime exploration.

guideSections.title: Farming, Potion-Brewing & Romance
guideSections.description: How Cursed Soil farming, cauldron potion-brewing, and the town's romance and marriage options with its supernatural cast fit together across the game's day-to-day loop.
